title: AgentConfig
description: Agent configuration. Source of truth for `docs/src/generated/agent-config.md`.

buffer_dir.description: Directory for on-disk push buffer when the server is unreachable.

ingest_token.description: Shared ingest token. This cannot call Docker manage APIs.

labels.description: Extra labels attached to every sample (`key=value` in TOML map).

node_id.description: Stable node id. Defaults to hostname when empty.

DockerConfig.description:
Docker Engine access on this node.

Socket access is root-equivalent. `manage` is opt-in. `allow_exec` is a further gate because exec is a root shell on the host namespaces.

compose_paths.description: Extra Compose file paths to manage (in addition to project labels).

enabled.description: Observe Docker (list/inspect/stats/logs) via the engine socket.

host.description: Engine socket or TCP URL. Empty uses `/var/run/docker.sock`.
